### GT save function

```{r save-func, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# save function
gt_save_crop <- function(
  data,
  file = NULL,
  bg = "white",
  whitespace = 50,
  zoom = 2,
  expand = 5
) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch(
    {
      gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
      message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
      gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
    }
  )

  magick::image_read(tmp) |>
    magick::image_trim() |>
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |>
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}


library(cbbplotR)
library(rlang)
library(gtUtils)
```

### Schedule gird

```{r sched-grid, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

sched <- readr::read_csv("schedule_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

p4 <- c("ACC", "B10", "B12", "SEC")
fbs <- c(p4, "AAC", "CUSA", "MAC", "MWC", "P12", "SUN", "IND")

conf_names <- c(
  B10 = "Big Ten",
  ACC = "ACC",
  SEC = "SEC",
  B12 = "Big 12",
  AAC = "American",
  SUN = "Sun Belt",
  MAC = "MAC",
  MWC = "Mountain West",
  CUSA = "CUSA",
  P12 = "Pac-12"
)

classify <- function(hc, ht, ac, at) {
  # Notre Dame is IND but counts as P4 for matchup typing
  hp4 <- hc %in% p4 | ht == "Notre Dame"
  ap4 <- ac %in% p4 | at == "Notre Dame"
  hfb <- hc %in% fbs
  afb <- ac %in% fbs
  dplyr::case_when(
    !hfb | !afb ~ "FBS vs FCS",
    hp4 & ap4 ~ "P4 vs P4",
    xor(hp4, ap4) ~ "P4 vs G5",
    .default = "G5 vs G5"
  )
}

# --- non-conference rows, typed --------------------------------------------
nonconf <- sched |>
  dplyr::filter(!conference_game) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    row = classify(home_conference, home_team, away_conference, away_team)
  ) |>
  dplyr::count(row, week) |>
  tidyr::complete(row, week = 0:15, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(group = "Non-conference matchups", projected = FALSE)

# --- conference rows, by league ---------------------------------------------
conf <- sched |>
  dplyr::filter(conference_game) |>
  dplyr::count(row = home_conference, week) |>
  tidyr::complete(row = names(conf_names), week = 0:15, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    projected = week == 14 | (row == "P12" & week == 13),
    n = dplyr::case_when(
      week == 14 ~ 1L, # title game, every league
      row == "P12" & week == 13 ~ 4L, # Pac-12 flex games
      .default = n
    ),
    row = conf_names[row],
    group = "Conference games"
  )

# aggregate Conference games row (10 title games projected in wk 14;
# the Pac-12 flex games are NOT in this row - designated non-conference)
conf_total_row <- sched |>
  dplyr::filter(conference_game) |>
  dplyr::count(week) |>
  tidyr::complete(week = 0:15, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    projected = week == 14,
    n = dplyr::if_else(week == 14, 10L, n),
    row = "Conference games",
    group = "Conference games"
  )

# row order: matchup types, aggregate in the middle, then
# Big Ten / SEC / ACC / Big 12, then the rest alphabetical
row_order <- c(
  "P4 vs P4",
  "P4 vs G5",
  "G5 vs G5",
  "FBS vs FCS",
  "Conference games",
  "Big Ten",
  "SEC",
  "ACC",
  "Big 12",
  "American",
  "CUSA",
  "MAC",
  "Mountain West",
  "Pac-12",
  "Sun Belt"
)

counts <- dplyr::bind_rows(nonconf, conf_total_row, conf) |>
  dplyr::mutate(row = factor(row, levels = rev(row_order)))

totals <- counts |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = sum(n), .by = row)

months <- sched |>
  dplyr::mutate(month = format(date, "%b")) |>
  dplyr::count(week, month) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(n, n = 1, by = week) |>
  dplyr::summarise(wk_min = min(week), wk_max = max(week), .by = month) |>
  dplyr::mutate(wk_min = dplyr::if_else(month == "Dec", 14, wk_min))

bg <- "#F0F0F0"

p <- ggplot2::ggplot(counts, ggplot2::aes(x = week, y = row, fill = n)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = bg, linewidth = 1.4, width = 0.96, height = 0.88) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(
    data = \(d) dplyr::filter(d, projected),
    fill = NA,
    color = "#a05a2c",
    linetype = "22",
    linewidth = 0.55,
    width = 0.96,
    height = 0.88
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = ifelse(n == 0, "", n), color = n >= 18),
    size = 3.2,
    family = "sans",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = totals,
    ggplot2::aes(x = 16.1, y = row, label = n),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.1,
    family = "sans",
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "grey40",
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  # one fill scale spanning all rows: breakpoints weighted to the low end
  # so 0-9 (league rows) stays differentiated while 50-65 (the aggregate
  # row's peak weeks) still reads dark
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "#fff1e0",
      "#ffd9a8",
      "#fdae61",
      "#f46d43",
      "#d73027",
      "#7f0d16"
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 2, 5, 9, 25, 65)),
    limits = c(0, 65),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "#571605"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = months,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = wk_min - 0.32,
      xend = wk_max + 0.32,
      y = 15.78,
      yend = 15.78
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = months,
    ggplot2::aes(x = (wk_min + wk_max) / 2, y = 16.02, label = month),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.1,
    family = "sans",
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "grey35"
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 16.02,
    xend = 16.72,
    y = 15.78,
    yend = 15.78,
    color = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = 16.37,
    y = 16.02,
    label = "Total",
    size = 3.1,
    family = "sans",
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "grey35"
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:15,
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(0.3, 1.3))
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(0.35, 0.35))) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "The shape of the college football season",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Every 2026 game featuring at least one FBS team, counted by week and type.",
      "<br>P4 vs P4 / G5 vs G5 only show non-conference matchups.<br>Dashed cells are scheduled, but matchups are not yet determined."
    ),
    x = "Week",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "data via collegefootballdata.com | Viz by Chris at Bless your Chart <br><br>P4 is ACC, Big Ten, Big 12, SEC (+ Notre Dame) <br> Week 15 is Army-Navy (designated non-conference game) <br> Pac-12 has 4 flex games in week 13 (designated non-conference matchups)."
  ) +
  ggthemes::theme_fivethirtyeight(base_size = 12, base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(
      size = 8.8,
      color = "grey25",
      lineheight = 1.15,
      margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 24)
    ),
    plot.caption = ggtext::element_markdown(
      size = 7.5,
      color = "grey45",
      hjust = 1,
      lineheight = 1.15
    ),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(
      size = 9,
      face = "bold",
      color = "grey15"
    ),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggplot2::ggsave(
  "season_shape_combined.png",
  p,
  width = 12,
  height = 9.0,
  dpi = 200,
  bg = bg
)
message("done")

p
```

### GT table for preseason ratings

```{r gt-tbl-preseason, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

ratings <- readr::read_csv(
  "ratings_preseason_2026.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

pairwise <- ratings |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    min_pair_gap = pmin(
      abs(fpi_pctile - sp_pctile),
      abs(fpi_pctile - fei_pctile),
      abs(sp_pctile - fei_pctile)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(min_pair_gap)) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) |>
  dplyr::select(
    team,
    conference,
    fei_pctile,
    fei_rank,
    sp_pctile,
    sp_rank,
    fpi_pctile,
    fpi_rank,
    min_pair_gap
  )

fball_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
      <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-football-college.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
     <div style='flex-grow:1; margin-left: 30px; margin-right: 30px'>
       <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>Nobody knows what to make of these teams ¯\\_(ツ)_/¯</span>
       <span style='font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center;'>10 teams that diverge the most across three preseason rating systems: FEI, SP+, and FPI.</span>
     </div>
     <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-football-college.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
   </div>
  <br>"
)

# quality ramp: low percentile = red, mid = pale yellow, high = green
quality_ramp <- c(
  "#67001f",
  "#d73027",
  "#fc8d59",
  "#fdbe6f",
  "#fee08b",
  "#d9ef8b",
  "#91cf60",
  "#1a9850"
)
tbl <- pairwise |>
  cbbplotR::gt_cbb_teams(team, team) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt_theme_almanac(accent = "#acacac") |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(team) |>
  gt::cols_align(team, align = "left") |>
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = team,
    col2 = conference,
    small_cap = FALSE,
    palette = c("black", "#333333")
  ) |>
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = fei_pctile,
    col2 = fei_rank,
    small_cap = FALSE,
    palette = c("black", "#333333"),
  ) |>
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = sp_pctile,
    col2 = sp_rank,
    small_cap = FALSE,
    palette = c("black", "#333333")
  ) |>
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = fpi_pctile,
    col2 = fpi_rank,
    small_cap = FALSE,
    palette = c("black", "#333333")
  ) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    team = "Team",
    fei_pctile = "FEI",
    sp_pctile = "SP+",
    fpi_pctile = "FPI",
    min_pair_gap = "Minimum Gap"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = gt::html("Preseason percentile (0-100) <br>preseason ranking"),
    columns = c(fei_pctile, sp_pctile, fpi_pctile)
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(fei_pctile, sp_pctile, fpi_pctile, min_pair_gap),
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(fei_pctile, sp_pctile, fpi_pctile),
    rows = 1,
    decimals = 1,
    pattern = "{x}%"
  ) |>
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c(fei_pctile, sp_pctile, fpi_pctile),
    fn = scales::col_numeric(palette = quality_ramp, domain = c(0, 100)),
    alpha = 0.6
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_text(weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = min_pair_gap)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(fball_header)) |>
  gtUtils::gt_border_grid(
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    include_labels = FALSE
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::px(450)) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(gt::html(
    "<hr>data via cfbtxt.com and rating sources below:<br>
     <hr>
     FEI ratings at bcftoys.com by Brian Fremeau
     <br>
     SP+ ratings at espn.com by Bill Connelly
     <br>
     FPI ratings by ESPN at espn.com/college-football/fpi
     <hr>
     Table by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  ))

gt::gtsave(tbl, "pairwise_divergence_table.png", vwidth = 1100)

tbl
```
